title: Peer spillover: do closely linked coins that have not moved follow a coin that reprices on its own?
frozen_note: Written after the feasibility check (counts only, FEASIBILITY_AMENDMENT_1.md, feasibility_v1.1/) and before any E8 code computed a forward return, high, low or other outcome.

data.source: Binance spot 1h klines, USDT pairs, delisted symbols included, checksum-verified
data.never_read: 2023 (inspected in E2 validation, cannot confirm anything new) and 2024 onward (sealed holdout)
data.excluded_assets: stablecoins and leveraged tokens (collection), PAXG and BKRW (amendment 1)

signal.definition: research/E8/FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md as amended by FEASIBILITY_AMENDMENT_1.md, implemented in idxsig/e8.py peer_events() at commit bfcf099; IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md notes 1-8
signal.in_words: leader: eligible coin up >= 25% in 24h, >= 20 points above the market median, on >= 3x its normal daily volume, first crossing in 72h. Peers: up to 3 eligible coins that have not moved (24h residual <= +5 points), not recent leaders, with partial correlation >= 0.20 to the leader over the 30 days before the move. One open event per coin.
signal.decision_time: close of hour t (all inputs from bars opening at or before t)
decision_hours: last hour whose holding window ends by 2022-12-31 23:00 UTC

early_warning_definition: The warning is issued for a coin whose 24-hour move is at most 5 points above the market median at the decision, i.e. before its own move. It is judged on what happens after the decision only.

moonshot_definition.U20: max high over bars t+1..t+72 >= 1.20 x entry price
moonshot_definition.U30: max high over bars t+1..t+72 >= 1.30 x entry price (reported, not gated)

outcomes.entry: open of bar t+1; no entry bar = NO_ENTRY (counted, unscored)
outcomes.R72: close of bar t+72 / entry - 1, gross; if bar t+72 is absent, the last present close in t+1..t+72, flagged missing_end
outcomes.latency_sensitivity: R72 with entry at the open of bar t+2 and exit at the close of bar t+73 (reported, not gated)

comparison.pool: coins eligible at t, not meeting the raw leader condition in t-72..t, residual 24h return <= +5 points (the same not-yet-moved filter), with a defined partial correlation to the event's leader below 0.10, an entry bar at t+1, and not the event coin
comparison.match_on: liquidity quintile (30-day median daily quote volume) and trailing-volatility quintile (720-bar hourly sd), quintiles computed within the pool at t
comparison.relaxation: if fewer than 5 pool coins share both quintiles: liquidity only; then the whole pool; level recorded
comparison.draws: 200 with replacement, numpy default_rng(20261016), events in time order
comparison.control_value: mean over the 200 draws of the same quantity (R72, U20, U30, plan net) from the same entry bar

trading_plan.side: long spot, no leverage, one position per event
trading_plan.exits: take profit at +20% (limit), stop at -10%, otherwise the close of bar t+72; bars t+1..t+72 are evaluated in order using high and low
trading_plan.same_bar_rule: if a bar reaches both levels the stop is assumed first
trading_plan.gap_rule: a bar opening below the stop fills at its open; take profit fills at +20% exactly
trading_plan.missing_bars: an absent bar offers no fill; if the coin has no bar after some point in the window, exit at the last present close, flagged
trading_plan.costs: fee 0.10% per side (Binance spot taker, no discount); slippage per side 0.10% if 30-day median daily quote volume >= $10M, else 0.20%; net = exit x (1 - fee - slip) / (entry x (1 + fee + slip)) - 1
trading_plan.size_and_capacity: notional of 1% of the coin's median hourly quote volume (liquidity / 24 x 1%), reported in USD; portfolio view: 5% of capital per trade, no compounding, no cap on concurrent positions, report maximum concurrent positions and maximum drawdown of cumulative net

statistics.dependence: ISO-week cluster bootstrap over decision weeks (idxsig.e6.week_bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261015); one-sided p = share of resampled means <= 0

gates.G0_sample: at least 300 scored events in at least 50 distinct weeks, and at most 5% of events unscorable (NO_ENTRY or NO_CONTROLS)
gates.G1_information: mean excess R72 (event minus control) > 0 with one-sided p < 0.025
gates.G2_moonshot: mean of (U20 - control U20 rate) > 0 with one-sided p < 0.025
gates.G3_trading: plan mean net > 0 with one-sided p < 0.05, and plan mean net minus control plan mean net > 0
gates.G4_consistency: mean excess R72 > 0 in 2021 and in 2022 separately (2020 reported)
gates.G5_robustness: mean excess R72 > 0 after dropping the two weeks with the most events

decision.FAIL: G0 holds and any of G1 to G5 fails
decision.high_win_rate_label: attached to a PASS only if the plan's Wilson 95% lower bound for the win rate exceeds 50%
decision.after_a_fail: the result is recorded and E8 stops; no threshold, window, plan or filter is changed and rerun
decision.after_a_pass: discovery only. No fresh historical crypto data exists (2023 inspected, 2024+ sealed), so confirmation is prospective paper tracking under this frozen plan, approved separately

claims.allowed: whether this exact rule and plan beat matched non-linked coins in 2020-07..2022 Binance spot data under the stated costs
claims.not_allowed: prospective performance, results for other markets, horizons, links or plans, or a claim that no spillover exists anywhere if it fails
